environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB with HTTP/2 listener downgrading to HTTP/1.1 for target group. The task execution role's IAM policy includes a dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition restricting PutItem to items where the partition key matches ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant-id}, and the ALB has a custom listener rule that applies AWS WAF WebACL with body inspection enabled (oversizeHandling: CONTINUE) using a custom rule group with a regex pattern set matching on conflicting Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding header combinations (priority 1, action BLOCK, field-to-match: Headers with match-scope ALL, oversize-handling MATCH). The ALB also enforces RFC 7230 compliance via its built-in HTTP desync mitigation mode set to 'strictest'.

config.waf_web_acl: Custom rule group priority 1: regex match on requests containing both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers simultaneously, action BLOCK, body inspection with oversizeHandling CONTINUE
config.network: ECS Fargate private subnet, backend reachable via service discovery
config.http_validation: ALB strictest desync mitigation + WAF header inspection
